gloss: entry field; blank space to fill in

definitions.gloss: entry field; blank space (on a form); fill-in section
definitions.explanation: A designated space on a form, document, or application where information is to be written or entered.

examples.japanese: {記入欄|きにゅうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Write your name in the entry field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記入欄|きにゅうらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{小|ちい}さすぎる。
examples.english: The address field is too small.

examples.japanese: ⟦{該当|がいとう}しない→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧{記入欄|きにゅうらん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ままにして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please leave blank any entry fields that do not apply to you.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧ (filling in, entering) and ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, section, field). Encountered frequently when dealing with official forms, applications, and paperwork in Japan. The suffix ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ is productive and appears in many form-related words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記入欄|きにゅうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the entry field
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧{記入欄|きにゅうらん}: required field
- {記入欄|きにゅうらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not enough space in the field

RELATED TERMS WITH {欄|らん}:
- ⟦{備考欄|びこうらん}→備考欄：17222_bikouran⟧: remarks section — for additional notes
- ⟦{署名欄|しょめいらん}→署名欄：30137_shomeiran⟧: signature field
- ⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧: blank space — an unfilled field
